security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Account-free artwork scraper for emulated games
bundle.longDescription: RomCrate finds box art, 3D boxes, screenshots, logos, videos and manuals for your emulated games and puts them where your launcher (Pegasus, ES-DE, EmulationStation, RetroArch, LaunchBox) expects them. No account, no tracking.
